title: Hits widget should support table as a valid container
body:
Here is my hits widget: ```js search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.hits({ container: '#donations', templates: { item: '{{created_at}}${{gross_amount}} {{donor}}' } }) ); ``` My markup: ```html
``` Apparently this code is not valid and I get this error message in the console: `Warning: validateDOMNesting(...):
cannot appear as a child of . See table > Hits > div.` Is it possible to use a `table` element as a container for hits?
